title: Select single-line payment journal route after global reconciliation posting gate

decision.rejectedRoute: Confirming Payment Reconciliation Journal / Post Payments Only after only selecting document 108204
decision.reasonRejected: The visible confirmation remains global: Do you want to post the payments? It does not prove that only document 108204 would be posted.
decision.selectedRoute: Single-line payment journal route with one target ledger entry, Journal Check, Apply Entries preflight, post dialog screenshot and ledger trace
decision.whySelected: PAYMENTS-011 and P2P-002 prove that RM-DEMO can post customer and vendor payments from scoped journal lines with preflight and trace evidence.

rebuildInstruction: In the German final sandbox, recreate the selected payment as a single journal line, capture Journal Check/Apply/Posting-dialog evidence, then trace vendor/customer, detailed ledger, bank account ledger and G/L entries.
targetGermanCompanyImpact: German bank, payment journal, posting groups, open item and ledger trace must be rebuilt with German accounts and screenshots.
nextStep: BANK-008-SINGLE-LINE-VENDOR-PAYMENT-PREFLIGHT: prepare a controlled single-line vendor payment journal preflight for document 108204 / First Up Consultants; no posting until Journal Check, Apply and trace gates are explicit.
